title: Buddy programme
description: Il programma buddy, organizzato dal Servizio relazioni internazionali e mobilità e ESN Lugano, ha lo scopo di sostenere gli studenti ospiti in mobilità all’USI e facilitare la loro integrazione nella comunità universitaria mettendoli in contatto con un gruppo composto da due…

blocks.html:
The buddy programme organized by the International Relations and Study Abroad Service and ESN Lugano aims to support exchange students at USI and facilitate their integration into the university community by connecting them with a group consisting of two USI students and 2–3 incoming students.

USI students are invited to volunteer as buddies and commit to assisting international students during their exchange.

What is a buddy?

A buddy is, first and foremost, a friend. As a buddy, your role is to make life a little easier for exchange students, helping them settle into campus life and feel welcome from day one.

Why become a buddy?

Participating in the buddy programme offers you the chance to have an international experience, meet people from all over the world, improve your language skills, explore new cultures, and create new friendships. In addition to helping others, it is a great way to enrich your CV!

How does it work?

You can sign up to be a buddy using the online form; you’ll then be assigned to a group consisting of two USI students and 2–3 exchange students, and ESN Lugano will put you in touch with them. To participate in the buddy program, you must attend a mandatory information session that will be held during the first week of the semester. You’ll also receive a brief buddy guide, which will provide more details about your role. You and your group can then decide how to proceed—whether that means meeting for coffee, exchanging messages, or going for a walk...

At the end of the semester, you’ll be asked to fill out a short feedback questionnaire and will receive a buddy certificate.

The registration deadline for the 2027 spring semester is 31 January, 2027.

Register here to become a buddy!
